youtube.title: David Seymour defends the India Free Trade Agreement.
youtube.summary: “We’ve got sheep meat, honey, wine, technology… there’s so much opportunity. And we get to sell all these things to them, instead of being beholden to China. That’s the real story that may have been missed here. And then you’ve had all this stuff about immigration. The reality is that if you add up all the visas that are allowed for Indian nationals under this Agreement, they add up to 6% of the number of visas that were issued to Indian nationals last year anyway”. RCR’s Tane Webster spoke with Deputy Prime Minister and ACT Leader David Seymour.
